reuse.why: The check goes into the existing link.ts module next to findOrCreateBank and is applied to all five provider handlers through one wrapper, without touching their bodies.

duplication.why: The uniqueness rule and its query are defined once. Each registration repeats the provider name already hard-coded inside its link function, plus a small id-extractor lambda.

placement.why: The rule sits in link.ts, the account-linking helper module. The wrapper function, though, is declared in the middle of the app.method registration block instead of with the other helpers.

scope.why: Only the rule, its wiring and tests; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Easy to change the rule in one place. A future provider must remember to wrap its handler, and its sync-source string is given twice (wrapper and link body).

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five *-accounts-link methods go through refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount and so through link.assertBankAccountNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the check exists once.

one_place.where: link.ts assertBankAccountNotLinked, applied to every link request by the refuseAlreadyLinkedBankAccount wrapper in accounts/app.ts.
